title: Data for: Contrasting elevational diversity patterns across three Neotropical moth lineages along an Amazon–Andes gradient
description: Abundance data of Arctiinae, Saturniidae and Sphingidae moths sampled with standardised light towers at 26 forest plots along an elevational gradient (245–3,588 m a.s.l.) in southeastern Peru in two campaigns (September–November 2022 and April–June 2023), with plot coordinates, elevation and environmental variables (mean annual temperature, mean annual precipitation, leaf net primary productivity). See README.md for a description of all files and variables.
